Name: Quest Vision - Indicator for Quests and Bundles
Author: Legolukas
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
Overwhelmed by a massive quest log? This mod is here to help!

QuestVision puts a small "!" on everything you still need. Items in your inventory, chests and shops, ripe crops in the field, and even the villager or box you have to hand them to. No more opening the journal, memorizing an item name, and searching through every chest on your farm.

[b]Key features[/b]
[list]
[*]Quests & special orders: Items needed for your active quests and special orders get a marker. Hover an item to see exactly which quest it belongs to, with the full quest text.[/*]
[*]Bundles: Community Center bundles and custom bundles from other mods are marked in their own color. You also get the full bundle with its checklist and reward. Bundles you haven't seen yet are never shown, so there are no spoilers.[/*]
[*]Mr. Raccoon: His current request is marked separately, including the exact preserved items he wants.[/*]
[*]Fishpond: Items that are requested from fishes in the fishpond will also be marked.[/*]
[*]Hand-in markers: A villager gets a "!" while you carry the item a quest wants from them. Special order donation boxes and the shipping bin get one too. Both also show on the world map and on minimaps, so you can see where to go.[/*]
[*]In the world: Needed forage, ripe crops, fruit trees and items on the ground are marked, so you don't have to search for them.[/*]
[*]Your colors: Every kind of marker has its own color, and you pick them in the settings. If an item is needed for several things at once, the icon is split into several colors.[/*]
[*]Pin quests: Pin in the journal with the small "!" on each row, or with the pin key (P by default).[/*]
[*]How to get (journal): The how-to-get tip when hovering a quest objective. (not every modded item is working yet)[/*]
[*]Easy to configure: Short in-game settings with Generic Mod Config Menu.. Everything can be switched off individually.[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52612/52612-1790256074-233981131.png[/img]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/SkgptFd.png[/img][/center]

1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install Generic Mod Config Menu (highly recommended for easy configuration).
3. Download this mod and extract it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2tjtjDL.png[/img][/center]

You can configure the mod in-game with the Generic Mod Config Menu (gear icon on the title screen, or at the bottom of the in-game options menu). The menu is short on purpose: one page with a few switches, a Colors page, and an Other mods page that only lists mods you have installed.

[b]Mark items for[/b]
[list]
[*]Quests & orders: items needed for your quests and special orders.[/*]
[*]Bundles: items needed for Community Center bundles and bundles from other mods. Only bundles you have actually seen are marked.[/*]
[*]Mr. Raccoon: items for the raccoon's current request, once he has asked.[/*]
[*]Fishponds: mark items for fishpond "quest"[/*]
[/list][b]Show markers[/b]
[list]
[*]On hover: a "!" next to the cursor.[/*]
[*]Details window: explains the quest, bundle or request in a pop-out in the bottom-right corner. Turn it off if you don't want it.[/*]
[*]On item slots: a "!" on needed items in inventories, chests, shops and crafting menus, even without hovering.[/*]
[*]In the world: a "!" above needed forage, ripe crops, fruit trees, items on the ground and finished machines.[/*]
[/list][b]Where to hand in[/b]
[list]
[*]Villagers: a "!" above the villager a quest item has to go to, while you carry it.[/*]
[*]Drop-off boxes: a "!" above the donation box or shipping bin a special order wants its items in.[/*]
[*]On the map: shows those villagers and boxes on the map and on minimaps.[/*]
[/list][b]Quest tracking[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pin quests:[/b] pin a quest in the journal (small "!" on each row, or the pin key). Its items get marked in chests and the quest is kept in a small window.[/*]
[*][b]Use Quest Journal pins[/b] (only if Quest Journal is installed): shares its pin list and shows only its window, so nothing is doubled. Turn off to keep QuestVision's own list and window.[/*]
[*][b]Pin key:[/b] pins or unpins the quest under the cursor in the journal (P by default).[/*]
[*][b]How to get (journal):[/b] hover the objective of an open quest to see how to get its item.[/*]
[*][b]Mark chests:[/b] a "!" above chests and the fridge that hold an item a pinned quest needs.[/*]
[*][b]World: pinned only:[/b] show quest items lying around in the world only for pinned quests.[/*]
[*][b]Pinned window:[/b] show the pinned quests in a small window.[/*]
[*][b]Window size[/b] (0.5x to 1.5x) and [b]Window opacity[/b] (30% to 100%).[/*]
[*][b]Window position:[/b] Right side (where Quest Journal's window sits, default), Left side, Top left, Bottom left, or Custom (dragged). Drag the window with the mouse to place it anywhere; right-click it to move it back.[/*]
[/list][b]Colors[/b]
[list]
[*]pick a color for each kind of marker (Gold, Orange, Red, Pink, Purple, Blue, Cyan, Green, Gray, White). Defaults: gold for quests, red for bundles, gray for Mr. Raccoon, cyan for fishpond, green for Nature in the Valley, blue for Stardew Aquarium. If an item is needed for several things, the icon is split into several colors. [/*]
[/list]
[b]Other mods[/b]: one switch per mod. Each does nothing if that mod isn't installed.

Without Generic Mod Config Menu you can edit config.json in the mod folder instead.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg7jJbF.png[/img][/center]
[left]

[i]Mods that should be compatible[/i]:[/left]
[list]
[*]UI Info Suite 2 (including the Alternative fork). The mod can leave out its own bundle hover info if UI Info Suite already shows it (switch in the settings).[/*]
[*]Better Crafting[/*]
[*]Convenient Inventory[/*]
[*]More Quests Framework[/*]
[*]Unlockable Bundles[/*]
[*]Nature in the Valley[/*]
[*]Stardew Aquarium[/*]
[*]NPC Map Locations[/*]
[*]Remapping[/*]
[*]Quest Journal (Pin mechanic only)[/*]
[/list][i]Mods that are not compatible[/i]:
Mods that change the UI might be incompatible. Let me know if that happens.
